source.title: ModelPred: A Framework for Predicting Trained Model from Training Data
source.authors: Ying-Yan Zeng; Jia-Chen T. Wang; Si Chen; Just Anh Hoang; Ran Jin; R. Jia

record.tranche_reason: The study estimates memorization scores and evaluates test accuracy after removing high-score training examples, bearing on V8 through a different estimation method. It does not test the stated comparison with random removals.
record.gate_note: The paper's other experiments predict trained parameters and evaluate data valuation, calibration, and selection; those results do not test the listed generalization versions. Memorization-score thresholds used to select removal levels are not separate results.
record.test_reason: Section 4.3 uses memorization-based removal to evaluate ModelPred against other estimators. The reported results establish estimator performance, without stating whether high-memorization removal lowers accuracy more than equal-sized random removal. MNIST additionally substitutes confidence change for label-prediction probability and uses logistic regression. These results do not establish a test of V8.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately summarizes the relevant application results: ModelPred improves the reported estimator comparison on Hymenoptera and approximates the solver's removal trend on MNIST. Higher accuracy relative to another estimator does not establish improvement relative to retaining all training examples. The paper's broader conclusion concerns predicting trained parameters and enabling efficient ML applications.
record.recipe_differences: The study estimates memorization scores using ModelPred and evaluates test accuracy after removing samples above score thresholds; it does not reproduce the original random-removal comparison.
record.method_sensitivity: Dataset and base model: Hymenoptera with a pre-trained NN versus MNIST with LR; the memorization-score estimator (ModelPred versus baseline or solver).

fits_no_version.finding: On Hymenoptera, removal using ModelPred memorization estimates yields higher test accuracy than removal using the baseline estimator; no comparison with equally many random removals is reported.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Memorization-score estimators can differ in the test accuracy obtained after threshold-based training-data removal.

fits_no_version.finding: On MNIST, ModelPred closely reproduces the solver's removal trend using confidence-based scores for deterministic logistic regression, taking 1.84% of the solver's estimation time.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: ModelPred can efficiently approximate confidence-based inclusion scores and their associated removal curves for logistic regression.

record.peer_reviewed: 2023 IEEE Conference on Secure and Trustworthy Machine Learning (SaTML)
record.problems: The removal results are presented in figures without numerical values in the text. The study does not compare against random removals, so it cannot establish the specific V8 comparison. The Hymenoptera setup uses a pre-trained network with its last layer trained for the task; MNIST uses deterministic LR.
record.rows_left_out: No rows retained: Figure 7 reports removal-threshold test-accuracy curves but the supplied text gives no numerical values, and its narrative compares estimators rather than the claimed random-removal baseline. See Section 4.3, Figure 7.

untested.parts: Whether removing the most memorized examples lowers test accuracy more than removing equally many random examples, including the stated dataset dependence. Figure 7 reports estimator comparisons without this control or a readable direction of the removal effect in the supplied text.

record.verdict_notes: Figure 7 is already declared in rows_left_out, so it is not a missing extraction. Its numerical curves are unavailable in the supplied text. Figure 6 includes random-removal controls, but selects examples by Shapley value after label corruption, rather than by the memorization measure named in V8.

versions.untested_parts: The study evaluates removal of samples selected by memorization scores on Hymenoptera and MNIST, but does not compare against removing the same number of random samples or test ResNet-50 on CIFAR-100 or ImageNet.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
